in_marathi.name: Apeksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Longing, Expectation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Apeksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The term ‘Apeksha’ is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘apekshya’ which means ‘to desire, to expect, to long for, or to look forward to’. It is a profound and powerful name that has been revered for centuries in Hindu culture. The name carries a deep spiritual significance and is believed to bring about a strong sense of determination, focus, and perseverance in the bearer.
